testimonials.r1_text: This will totally change how audio sounds on your Mac. It's especially apparent with headphones. If you've got weak headphones, this app will make them sound like a $200 pair.
testimonials.r2_text: I'm listening to all my favourite music all over again. I use studio monitors connected to my Mac and now I know at last what they can really do. I'm very glad I got Boom.

audio.mac_f1_desc: Boom 2 comes with a system-wide volume booster and equalizer so that every audio, video, music & movie on OS X sounds just the way it was meant to!

audio.ios_f3_subtitle: Control the intensity of your sound
